newsitem.title: USA: Taco Cabana to take Q4 charge.
newsitem.headline: Taco Cabana to take Q4 charge.

text.p: Taco Cabana Inc said Tuesday it expected to take a pre-tax charge ranging from $2.2 million to $2.5 million in the fourth quarter in order to write down its investment in a joint venture.
The company said the joint venture, in which it has a 50 percent interest, had opened three restaurants in Atlanta, one of which closed at the end of December.
"Expanding the Atlanta market does not fit into our near term growth strategy of opening restaurants in either established markets or mid-scale markets," it said.
Taco Cabana did not say with which company it had entered the venture.
Company officials could not be reached for comment.
